{"code":"# Calculate overall response rates by arm
overall_rates = df.groupby('arm')['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
overall_rates.columns = ['Arm', 'Response Rate', 'Sample Size']

# Calculate response rates by arm and severity
severity_rates = df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
severity_rates.columns = ['Arm', 'Severity', 'Response Rate', 'Sample Size']

print("Overall response rates by arm:")
print(overall_rates.to_string(index=False))

print("\nResponse rates by arm and severity:")
print(severity_rates.to_string(index=False))"}
